g.text: Graph revision AD - ga_side: Bed 3000 mm between the perforated support plate and the drip-pipe distributor; mesh demister above; sump on the plinth (AQS-DUTY-061 house classes)
Graph revision AD - ga_side: No liquor inlet is piped (duty section 2): the scrub liquor loop is the S69B return
Graph revision AD - ga_side: Gas in low on -Y, electrolyte return out on +Y, drain boss under the plinth, vent riser flush at the envelope top (the 2000 datum is the placeholder, W12(4))
Graph revision AD - ga_side: The HTU stays the duty packing figure, not a measured transfer unit (duty section 8, W12(2))
